nodes.text: Proximal shoulder and pelvic girdle aching + morning stiffness + ESR > 40 mm/h: diagnose PMR
Screen carefully for giant cell arteritis: ask regarding headache, jaw claudication, or vision loss

Initiate low-dose oral prednisone with prompt dramatic clinical response expected within 48-72 hours
Taper prednisone gradually over 12 months based on clinical symptom resolution and normalization of ESR/CRP
**Frequent relapses during steroid taper:** add methotrexate as steroid-sparing agent
Prevent glucocorticoid-induced osteoporosis: co-prescribe calcium, vitamin D, and bisphosphonate
